cards.card_text: A servant of the king of Israel says Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He “used to pour water on the hands of Elijah,” the prophet the LORD took up to heaven in a whirlwind (2 Kings 2:1, 11).
cards.verse_text: But Jehoshaphat asked, “Is there no prophet of the LORD here? Let us inquire of the LORD through him.” And one of the servants of the king of Israel answered, “Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah.”
